### Bible Pathway - February 10
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-feb-10-2013.html
Passage: Leviticus 24:5-9
Points:
- The twelve loaves placed continuously before God signify that He and His Word sustain our lives.
- The unleavened fine flour points to Jesus Christ as the sinless, perfect One who sustains His people.
- The baking and presentation of the bread picture Christ's suffering before becoming the Bread of Life.
- The frankincense placed with the loaves represents prayer and praise, showing how worship accompanies spiritual nourishment.
- Illuminated by the lampstand, the bread reminds believers that the Holy Spirit illuminates scripture to guide our lives.
